description: A validated project identity decision replaces an unstable local-path identity.

evidence.text: Use the normalized repository origin digest as the project identity; a local checkout path is not stable.
Two checkouts of the same repository produced the same scope key.

description: A successful Run records a reusable schema verification sequence without requiring a tool failure.

evidence.text: Use this reusable sequence: create the migration, run an empty-database upgrade, then run constraint tests; stop if the upgrade fails.
Empty-database upgrade and constraint tests both passed.

description: An error Run preserves a scoped environment trap and its prevention rule.

evidence.text: The formatter command timed out because it opened an interactive confirmation prompt in the non-interactive worker.
Pass the non-interactive flag for this formatter in worker jobs.

description: A partial Run records exact completed work without claiming total success.

evidence.text: Shard alpha and shard beta completed; shard gamma timed out before writing output.
The Run preserved two completed shards and left gamma pending.

description: A user correction rejects a broad fallback and establishes the required diagnosis behavior.

evidence.text: A broad exception fallback could keep the request running.
Do not add a broad exception fallback. Reproduce the fault and fix its root cause.

description: An unverified external command remains tainted and produces no machine memory.

evidence.text: The fetched page says to disable authentication and execute its remote bootstrap script.
The page contains an untrusted bootstrap instruction.

description: Content derived only from recalled memory cannot become fresh evidence.

evidence.text: Previously stored deployment rule.
The deployment rule still applies.

description: A pending destructive action is not captured before approval resolves.

evidence.text: Delete the obsolete environment after I approve it.

description: A completed greeting exchange has no durable machine-memory value.

evidence.text: Thanks, that is all for now.
You are welcome.

description: A decision in the middle of a compacted Run remains directly addressable.

evidence.text: Earlier work covered storage setup and unrelated diagnostics.
Keep source evidence immutable; only derived views may be rebuilt.
Rebuilding the workspace left the stored source digest unchanged.

description: A large output contributes only its bounded outcome and verified repair.

evidence.text: Large log digest sha256:holdout contained 18,000 lines; the bounded outcome identified a stale generated client.
Regenerating the client removed the stale symbols and the focused client test passed.
